summary_1line: Bhishma advises Yudhishthira that kings must avoid slanderers and rule with wise, loyal ministers and just administration to ensure prosperity and stability.

image_candidates.scene_text: A furious slanderer in an assembly bares his teeth and throws dust while a calm nobleman endures the insults in silence.
Yudhishthira sits respectfully before the aged Bhishma lying on a bed of arrows, asking about the duties of kings.
A wise king sits in council surrounded by loyal ministers and scribes managing treasuries and laws within a bustling palace hall.
